During my time in Santa Cruz, I attempted to engage with the broader community through the following activities.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Project for Inmate Education
I served as a co-director for the [**Project for Inmate Education (PIE)**](https://www.physics.ucsc.edu/news-events/community-programs/index.html#:~:text=Project%20for%20Inmate%20Education%20Program%20(PIE)) from July 2023 to August 2025. At PIE, we teach incarcerated persons courses on Pre-algebra, College algebra and Introduction to Astronomy at the Santa Cruz Main Jail.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Math Circles
- I was an active instructor with the [**Math Student Circle**](https://www.xacademy.org/math) in Santa Cruz, held at Cabrillo College. I lead activities on *Cryptography*, *Eulerian Circuits* and the *Four Colour Theorem*.
- I was an active participant of the [**Math Teachers’ Circle**](https://people.ucsc.edu/~pmorale5/mtc/) at Santa Cruz, where I lead sessions on *Gerrymandering*.
:::

I organised and assumed the following roles in service of supporting the mathematics community at UCSC.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Head TA
From July 2022 to June 2025, I served as a **Head TA** (now *Teaching support and Administrative Coordinator*) in the Mathematics Department, where we assisted the department in supporting Graduate Teaching Assistants.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Peer Support Program
I helped co-found and co-organised the Math Department **Peer Support Program** since August 2021 until June 2025. The program supports first-year graduate students in navigating the department and program milestones.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Directed Reading Program
I was an organiser of the [**Directed Reading Program**](https://sites.google.com/ucsc.edu/drp-math/) - where we pair undergraduates with graduate students to work on a reading project - from Fall 2021, when I helped restart the program after a brief hiatus during the pandemic, to March 2025. I have participated as a mentor myself several times, and you can [view the interesting topics my mentees and I have worked on here](mentoring.qmd). You will also find my mentees and the topics they worked on from my time with [**Twoples**](https://sites.google.com/view/twoples/home), an online program inspired by DRP.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Association for Women in Mathematics
I helped co-found the **[Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM) Chapter](https://sites.google.com/ucsc.edu/awm/)** with Jennier Guerrero in November 2020, and served as its president in AY 2022-23.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Other Departmental Service
- I served as a *study leader* for the **Prelim Study Sessions**, where we supported graduate students preparing for the departmental preliminary exams. I served as a leader for all three subjects: *Algebra* (Winter 2025, Spring 2024, Summer 2023), *Analysis* (Spring 2025, Winter 2022, Summer 2022) and *Geometry* (Winter 2022, Summer 2022).
- I supported the organising of **[EmpowHER Hour](https://sites.google.com/ucsc.edu/awm/)**, an AWM initiative (Spring 2022 - Spring 2023). This was a space where graduate students got together to hold meaningful discussions about gender equity in academia, and how one can help build a more inclusive mathematical community.
- I served as one of the founding Graduate Student representative on the **Mathematics Department DEI Committee** from Fall 2020 - Spring 2022.
- During COVID, I hosted and lead the Mathematics Department GSI Support sessions to create a space for peer support amongst the Graduate Student Instructors, from Feb - Aug 2021.
:::
